record.question: The recipient of the Bharat Ratna Award 2019 who hailed from North-East India was
record.explanation: Answer B: Bhupen Hazarika. The President’s January 2019 communique named Bhupen Hazarika (posthumously) among Bharat Ratna awardees; he was from Assam in Northeast India. Reference: https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleaseIframePage.aspx?PRID=1561485. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: June 2019 (cover; exact day not printed).
